models.name: S-Bahn 480 · Toaster
models.notes: Original simplified two-car quarter train. Flat cab and burgundy lower body distinguish it from the newer generations.

models.name: S-Bahn 481/482 · Taucherbrille
models.notes: Representative four-car half train with the rounded twin-window driving face. Actual trains can contain four, six or eight cars.

models.name: S-Bahn 483 · Quarter train
models.notes: Two-car current-generation quarter train. Shared exterior language with BR 484; a separately usable consist.

models.name: S-Bahn 484 · Half train
models.notes: Four-car current-generation half train. Two units can be coupled for a full Ringbahn train.

models.name: U-Bahn A3 · Classic small profile
models.notes: Classic narrow-profile yellow twin unit. Simplifies the A3 subseries into one recognizable family; dimensions approximate.

models.name: U-Bahn GI/1E · Gisela
models.notes: Narrow angular East Berlin train, represented with two door pairs per car and a four-car formation. Approximate envelope.

models.name: U-Bahn HK · Small profile
models.notes: Four-car walk-through small-profile unit with a sloping dark cab mask. Representative dimensions.

models.name: U-Bahn IK · Icke
models.notes: Modern four-car small-profile train. Also used with platform-gap adaptations in the large-profile network; those minor fittings are omitted.

models.name: U-Bahn JK · New small profile
models.notes: New small-profile generation in passenger service since September 2025. Tall dark cab face and clean yellow body; simplified fittings.

models.name: U-Bahn F · Classic large profile
models.notes: Classic wide-profile twin unit. Collapses the F subseries into one family; couple multiple units for longer trains.

models.name: U-Bahn H · Large profile
models.notes: Six-car walk-through large-profile train. Same broad visual family as HK with different width and consist length.

models.name: U-Bahn J · New large profile
models.notes: New large-profile generation introduced in May 2026. Representative four-car unit, usable in longer formations.

models.name: BVG Flexity · 30 m
models.notes: Short five-section family with alternating long and suspended sections. Cab/door layouts simplify single- and double-ended variants.

models.name: BVG Flexity · 40 m
models.notes: Long seven-section Flexity family; representative 40 m envelope and roof equipment.

models.name: BVG Urbanliner · 51 m
models.notes: Nine-section Urbanliner. Regular passenger debut on M4 in July 2026; broad black face and very long articulation pattern.

models.name: BVG GT6N/U · Single ended
models.notes: Three-section 1990s family. Single driving cab and right-side doors; can form the familiar coupled pair.

models.name: BVG GT6Z · Double ended
models.notes: Three-section double-ended GT6 with doors on both sides. Representative southeast-network asset.

models.name: Woltersdorf Moderus Gamma
models.notes: Short single-body low-floor tram on two bogies for line 87. Cream/green approximation; no heritage Gotha substitution implied.

models.name: SRS Artic · Line 88
models.notes: Rounded green/cream tram with four bogies. Line 88 is Schoeneiche-Ruedersdorf; Strausberg line 89 is not in the supplied feed list.

models.name: SRS KTNF6 · Line 88
models.notes: Angular Tatra ends and inserted low-floor center. Current SRS alternative; does not represent retired regular BVG KT4D service.

models.name: Potsdam Combino XL
models.notes: White/red Potsdam articulated family, represented by the longer seven-section silhouette. Approximate dimensions.

models.name: Potsdam Variobahn
models.notes: Five-section Potsdam family with rounded cab glazing. Simplified white/red fleet colors and approximate envelope.

models.name: Potsdam Tramlink
models.notes: New seven-section white/red Potsdam tram. Passenger debut on 92 in December 2025; wraps and individual graphics omitted.

models.name: BVG city bus · 12 m
models.notes: Original representative single-deck city bus. Combines the familiar yellow low-floor bus shapes without pretending to identify a manufacturer from a route label.

models.name: BVG articulated bus · 18 m
models.notes: Three axles and a separately pivotable rear section with accordion bellows. Diesel city-bus representative.

models.name: BVG electric bus · 12 m
models.notes: Electric solo silhouette with large battery/HVAC roof pods. Manufacturer-level details intentionally combined.

models.name: BVG electric articulated · 18 m
models.notes: New-generation yellow electric articulated bus with roof batteries and charging pantograph. Representative for 300; assignments are not permanent.

models.name: BVG Enviro500 · Double deck
models.notes: Three-axle Berlin double decker with two full window decks and three right-side doors. Simplified original mesh based on manufacturer dimensions.

models.name: Traditionsbus · Heritage 218
models.notes: Two-axle cream heritage double decker. Suitable for historic 218 workings, not every departure; approximate dimensions.

models.name: Regional low-entry bus
models.notes: Neutral white/blue regional bus for routes whose agency is missing. This livery is deliberately generic, not a claim about a Brandenburg operator.

models.name: BER2 airport coach
models.notes: Tall luggage-floor airport coach. BER2 operator is verified; exact dispatched coach type and detailed livery are not. White/red representative.

models.name: DB Regio · Double deck + locomotive
models.notes: Four double-deck coaches and an electric locomotive; cab-control coach at the opposite end. Representative formation, not a live consist.

models.name: DB Talent 2 · Hamster
models.notes: Five-car articulated red EMU, black rounded hamster face and shared bogies. Three-car and coupled formations reuse this visual family.

models.name: ODEG Desiro HC
models.notes: Single-deck driving cars and double-deck intermediate cars are preserved. Green/white body and yellow doors; representative four-car formation.

models.name: ODEG KISS
models.notes: Four-car green/white double-deck EMU, including double-deck end cars. Separately identifiable from mixed-height Desiro HC.

models.name: NEB Mireo Plus B · Battery
models.notes: Blue/light-gray two-car battery train, yellow doors, angular cab and pantograph. Representative RB25 family.

models.name: NEB Mireo Plus H · Hydrogen
models.notes: Same basic body as Plus B with distinct rooftop hydrogen tanks and no overhead pantograph. Representative RB27 family.

models.name: NEB Pesa Link · Shark
models.notes: Two-car diesel unit with projecting shark-like nose. Blue/white/yellow NEB approximation for RB26.

models.name: DB LINT 41
models.notes: Compact red two-car diesel family. RB55 assignment based on the network contract; present-day exact class is not established by the feed.

models.name: ICE 1 · Power heads
models.notes: Modernized nine-passenger-coach formation plus two windowless wedge power heads. Approximate 279 m envelope.

models.name: ICE 2 · Half train
models.notes: One windowless power head, six intermediate passenger cars and a cab-control passenger coach. Representative half train.

models.name: ICE 3 · Streamlined EMU
models.notes: Long tapered bullet nose, continuous passenger cars and distributed traction. Combines the closely related ICE 3 exterior generations.

models.name: ICE 4 · Long formation
models.notes: Twelve-car angular-nose ICE 4. Seven- and thirteen-car versions are not separate meshes; exact train-number allocations need travel-day formation data.

models.name: ICE T · Tilting EMU
models.notes: Seven-car tilting-train silhouette with shorter rounded driving nose. No mechanical tilting animation is baked into the asset.

models.name: Intercity 2 · Double deck
models.notes: Five white/red double-deck coaches plus locomotive. Appropriate family for 2026 Rostock-Berlin-Dresden services including IC 2177; not the former IC KISS.

models.name: EuroCity · Conventional coaches
models.notes: Six conventional white/blue coaches and blue/gray electric locomotive. Representative EC family; exact EC 246 formation and livery are unresolved.

models.name: CD ComfortJet · Berliner
models.notes: Nine blue/white coaches, driving trailer and separate locomotive. Berliner / RJ 178 family, not red OeBB railjet.

models.name: Unidentified passenger train
models.notes: Neutral four-car placeholder for insufficient feed metadata such as bare label 1236. Does not identify a real train class or operator.

models.name: F23 FaehrBaer · Solar catamaran
models.notes: Twin narrow hulls, broad passenger deck and dark solar-panel canopy. Length/width from operator; simplified deck fittings and approximate height.
